about: MB x Vibecode: Credits Importer – the data of its mapping register (role rules, company roles, questions, tables and word lists, the quick switches). Loaded by the script (@resource mapping); the rules with code stay in the script. Regular expressions are {"$re": source, "$flags": flags}, sets {"$set": [...]}, maps {"$map": [[key, value], ...]}.

WORDING_RULES.note: Upright bass is a double bass; the Discogs word stays as role credit
Contrabass is a double bass; the Discogs word stays as role credit

Kontrabass (German) is always a double bass – a translation, MusicBrainz's own name, no role credit (3.22.3; 3.22.2: "contrabass", before: "Kontrabass"). The English "Contrabass" keeps "contrabass" (W002)
Violoncello is a cello; the word stays as role credit "violoncello" (3.22.2; a fixed pair like W002, W003 – no rule for other words)
"Horn [French]" and "French Horn" are the MusicBrainz instrument French horn, without role credit
"Flugel Horn" (also Flügelhorn) is the MusicBrainz instrument flugelhorn, without role credit
"Mix", "Mixed By", "Engineer [Mix]" … are the MusicBrainz relationship mix, without role credit
"Recording", "Recorded By", "Engineer [Recording]", "Live Recording By" … are the MusicBrainz relationship recording (recording engineer), without role credit

QUESTION_RULES.note: Plain "Bass": which bass? (3.97.0, Z-QGTR: or bass guitar, the family)
Plain "Guitar": which guitar? (3.97.0, Z-QGTR: or guitar itself)

Plain "Bouzouki" (3.105.0; collected item Z-BZK): which bouzouki? – the bouzouki itself and every kind of it in MusicBrainz's instrument tree (as written while the tree is not there); 3.107.0 (Z-ITREE): the kinds from the instruments' "type of" relationships
Plain "Bass Guitar": which bass guitar? Without a choice it stays bass guitar
"Horns" (3.42.3, Q-dh, Q-dm): horn credited "horns" – set at once – or brass credited "horns" (a horn section); (3.97.0, Z-QGTR) or wind instruments credited "horns" (brass and saxophones)

TYPE_QUESTIONS.note: "Directed By": conductor, chorus master, creative direction or miscellaneous support (task "director")? Nothing is assumed
"Alto" alone (3.21.2): the viola (Spanish, French), an alto saxophone or an alto voice? Nothing is assumed, no role credit

"Translated By", "Translation", "English Translation", "Translation (French)", "Übersetzung", "Traducción" … from every source (3.21.4 Bandcamp; Z-ENGTR 3.109.0 every source): mostly the liner notes – taken so at once, liner notes with the attribute translator (a suggestion) – or the lyrics: translator on the works of the tracks the source names, without tracks a suggestion on every work (as S024). No role credit; the language is kept nowhere (MusicBrainz has it only on the work itself)
"Sounds" (3.30.6): performer (without role credit) or the instrument effects credited "sounds"? Until answered it stays performer

"Poems", "Poetry", "Poem" alone (3.31.4): the words of the works (lyricist), poems printed in the booklet (liner notes) or poems read out (spoken vocals)? Nothing is assumed; each gets the word in lower case as role credit ("poems", "poetry", "poem")

A credit of poems switched to the release level (3.32.7; R105, R106, R107 – their type follows the level: works lyricist, recordings spoken vocals): the words of the works (lyricist), poems read out (spoken vocals) or poems printed in the booklet (liner notes)? Each keeps the role credit ("poems", "poetry", "recitation" …)

"Voice" alone (3.34.20; 3.34.25 every source, also Discogs): plain vocals (MusicBrainz has no role credit for them), other vocals, lead vocals or spoken vocals credited "voice"? Until answered it stays vocals without role credit; with another voice chosen by hand "voice" is offered as its role credit. "Vocals" stays vocals without a question (R018)
"Text" alone (3.21.0): liner notes – an essay in the booklet – or the lyrics (in German "Text" is the lyrics)? Nothing is assumed
"Host", "Hosted By" (3.41.8, Q-cn): spoken vocals credited "host", miscellaneous support (task "host") or skipped? Nothing is assumed
A member below the heading of a group (3.79.0; collected item Z-MEM): performer on the recordings (suggested; the level can be changed) or no relationship? Nothing is added before it is answered

ROLE_RULE_DATA.note: Music and lyrics (words) in one credit, or "All Songs By": writer; new works of these tracks get the work type "Song" (S020)

"Poems By", "Poetry By", "Poem By" (3.31.4): the poet is the lyricist of the works, with the role credit "poems", "poetry" or "poem" (lower case)

ROLE_RULE_DATA.note: "Host", "Hosted By" (3.41.8, Q-cn): spoken vocals credited "host", miscellaneous support "host" or skipped – no type is assumed, the dashboard asks (Q012); until 3.41.7 spoken vocals (R012)

"Vocal sample", "drum sample" (3.49.0, Z-ROL; Q-eu, Q-fe): material of the person that was sampled – samples from artist ("contains samples by"); next to the instrument of the same person ("drums / drum sample") the texts read it as sampler

Poems read out (3.31.4): "Recitation", "Recited By", "Poetry Reading", "Poems Read By", "Poetry [Read By]", "Poems [Recited By]" → spoken vocals on the recordings, with the role credit "poetry", "poems", "poem" or "recitation" (lower case)
"Poems", "Poetry", "Poem" alone (3.31.4): the words of the works, poems printed in the booklet or poems read out? No type is assumed, the dashboard asks (Q009)
Production
Only producer and co-producer belong on recordings by default; the other producer roles on the release.
"Produced By" (also "Produced-By", "Produced") is always producer
"Live Recording By" (also "Live Recording", "Recorded Live By" …) is recording too, without role credit; it is a hint for "live" (S021)

ROLE_RULE_DATA.note: "Remix", "Remixed By" and, Z-ENGRR (3.111.0), "Engineer [Remix]" (also a part of "Engineer [Recording & Remix]") are the remixer
Arrangement, conducting, ensembles
"Directed By" is not always conducting: no type is assumed, the dashboard asks (Q003)
"Alto" alone: in Spanish and French the viola, in English an alto saxophone or an alto voice – nothing is assumed, the dashboard asks (Q006); no role credit (3.21.2)
"Text" alone: liner notes (an essay in the booklet) or the lyrics (German "Text")? No type is assumed, the dashboard asks (Q005, 3.21.0)
"Cover Artwork" (3.29.0)
"Sounds" (3.30.6): performer – or the instrument effects credited "sounds"; the dashboard asks (Q008), performer until then
"Logo", "Logo by": design with the credit "logo" (3.21.0)
Creative direction: on the release group (3.39.5; MusicBrainz has it on recordings and release groups only, on the release art direction)
Miscellaneous

re.$re: ^(field recording|field recordings|field recordist|field recordings by|field recorded by)$

ROLE_RULE_DATA.note: Instrument technicians (3.34.25: with their instrument – the word before "technician" or a detail, "Technician [Guitar]"; T001 spellings)
"Commissioned By": the work was commissioned by them (a work-level role); without a track list a suggestion on all works (S024)
Camera work (3.79.0; collected item Z-CAM2): miscellaneous support on the recordings, the word as written (in lower case) as task – "Cameras" → cameras; the level can be switched to the release
Portraits (3.81.0; collected item Z-POR): "Album portraits by", "Portraits by" – photography on the release, the word as written (in lower case) as role credit ("album portraits")

Instruments by their model (3.81.0; collected item Z-SYN): a model of a synthesizer, drum machine or sampler (T065: "Juno 101", "Korg Minilogue", "TR-808", "MPC") – MusicBrainz's instrument of that name if it has one, else synthesizer, drum machine or sampler; the model as written as role credit
A member of a group – a name below its heading (3.79.0; collected item Z-MEM, S113) – or the group itself (S114): performer on the recordings? No type is assumed, the dashboard asks (Q013)
Plated By: miscellaneous support with the task “vinyl plating” on the release – only for vinyl (S026)
Typesetting (3.101.0; collected item Z-CIMP): design credited "typesetting" on the release
Hospitality (3.101.0; collected item Z-CIMP): miscellaneous support with the task "hospitality" on the release
Little instruments (3.102.0; collected item Z-LITI): other instruments credited as written ("little instruments")
Roles without an MB relationship type: added as "misc" with the Discogs role as task
